Bash(echo "=== Skill Validation ==="
for dir in ~/.qoder/skills/*/; do
  skill=$\(basename "$dir"\)
  if [ -f "$dir/SKILL.md" ]; then
    # Check frontmatter
    has_fm=$\(head -1 "$dir/SKILL.md" | grep -c "^---$"\)
    # Check name field
    has_name=$\(grep -c "^name:" "$dir/SKILL.md"\)
    # Check description field
    has_desc=$\(grep -c "^description:" "$dir/SKILL.md"\)
    # Count lines
    lines=$\(wc -l < "$dir/SKILL.md"\)
    # Count supporting files
    extras=$\(find "$dir" -not -name "SKILL.md" -type f | wc -l\)
    echo "OK: $skill \(fm:$has_fm name:$has_name desc:$has_desc lines:$lines extras:$extras\)"
  else
    echo "MISSING: $skill/SKILL.md"
  fi
done)
